title: Let gratitude take ego's medicine
subtitle: For self-importance that needs the Guru's cure
description: The hero lines name haumai as chronic disease and locate the cure inside grace and the Guru's Shabad. This path lets gratitude become treatment, exposing the mercy self-importance keeps pretending it produced.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Haumai is not a personality quirk; it is disease, and grace places the Guru's Shabad where the medicine must work.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When importance rises, name one mercy you did not manufacture and let that gratitude lower the next action.

evidence.coreClaim: This path uses gratitude as medicine for the self that keeps claiming authorship.
evidence.turn: Ego softens when mercy is no longer abstract; the received gift exposes the false story of self-making.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before defending importance, thank one unearned mercy and let the gratitude change your tone, spending, or apology.
